text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Let's go check that out for a second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following after Mr. C.B., I found a claw machine filled with Umamusume-themed plushies.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I walk by, I can't help but take a peek.
Like, "I wonder who's here today?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, look! It captures everyone's traits really well, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm! If I were good at this sort of thing,
I'd take it home with me, though...
choice_data_list: I'll get it for you, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
! Whoa, amazing!
Are you good at delicate tasks like this?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, nice.
Show me everything just the way your heart desires.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Show me a new side of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
